summary.what_it_does: The page is an OpenAI Help Center article about winding down Sora. It states that the Sora web and app experiences were discontinued on April 26, 2026, and the Sora API on September 24, 2026. Users can export content they created by visiting sora.chatgpt.com/sunset and clicking Export, then receive an email when the file is ready. After discontinuation, OpenAI says it will permanently delete data associated with Sora use, after any final export window if one is offered. Purchased ChatGPT or Sora credits can still be used for Codex. Refund questions are referred to a separate ChatGPT subscription refund article.
notable: Web and app experiences discontinued April 26, 2026
Content export via sora.chatgpt.com/sunset with email notification

caveats: The Sora service has been discontinued, so it is no longer available for new use
Data is permanently deleted after discontinuation and any final export window
A final export window is only offered if OpenAI is able to provide one
